defect.finding: DMRG (∞) -0.495186(1) per site (Table I, J2 = 0.55, L = 6; transcribed correctly, -71.306784 total, sigma 0.000144) sits 8.3e-6 per site = 8.3 printed bars below the exact ground-state energy of this instance, E0/N = -0.495177700 (QMBL Lanczos, qmbl-runs/qmbl-ed-2026-09-28, k = 0 A1, -71.305588859664 total; the stored Schulz, Ziman & Poilblanc row -0.495178 agrees). The paper's own 8192-state energy -0.495167 lies 1.07e-5 above E0, so the straight-line extrapolation overshoots by 78% of the remaining gap. The printed (1) is a fit uncertainty (how estimated is not stated; the authors withdrew their L = 10 bars as 'not accurate'), not a total error. The same column at the other three L = 6 couplings sits -2.0 (J2 = 0.4), -2.6 (0.45) and +1.7 (0.5) bars from E0 (chi2 = 82 over the four), so the bar is understated throughout, but only this row passes 3 sigma. Extrapolated, so the flag withholds no record; it tells readers not to use the 1e-6 bar.
